title: B5 agent output (b5-key-copier)
description: Section 10/B5 'Agent output' line and the b5-key-copier agent file (Appendix B), including its worked examples. This agent is deliberately never given a paper file -- only the key image/text layer -- since the real scraped papers' own embedded 'correct answer' highlighting is measurably unreliable (7%-48% mismatch by subject, Master Plan Section 2.1.1 #2); the key is the sole trustworthy answer source.

booklet_code.description: The booklet code printed on the key itself.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.

answer.description: '1'-'4', a comma list when more than one option is accepted, or '' when the cell shows only a mark.
